NHTSA Proposes Update to Odometer Disclosure Rules for Electronic Titles

October 9, 2026

WASHINGTON – The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration today proposed changes to the odometer disclosure requirements for vehicles titled electronically.

“Electronic titling is growing in every region, and the disclosure rules should keep pace,” said NHTSA Administrator Reginald Okonkwo-Barnes.

Comments on the proposal are due December 8, 2026, under the docket listed in the notice.
